class_id: a document typed by a default instead of by evidence, so a non-offer file outranks the real offer document
feature: any path that assigns documents.type to a third-party-linked PDF from a heuristic with a fall-through default (file name, folder, list the link came from) and writes it as a rank-bearing type (PROSPECTUS, RHP, DRHP)
symptom: a classifier that returns a rank-bearing type when nothing in the input names one. Because OD-30 makes the final prospectus terminal and OD-154 ranks PROSPECTUS first for every non-price field, any file the default mistypes (an annual report, a notice, a dead link serving an HTML page) would outrank the real RHP for every field it fed. The default is invisible while the input happens to be right: the rows look correct until the first non-offer file arrives, and the stored type then reads as evidence it never was.
first_seen: 2026-10-02 -- `detectProspectusDocType` (scraper/src/scrapers/chittorgarh-document-scraper.ts, issue #1417), measured read-only on ipodhan_staging: of 81 documents written by the Chittorgarh path (title ending '(Chittorgarh)'; 74 PROSPECTUS, 7 RHP), 19 have a URL file name that classifies to none of DRHP/RHP/PROSPECTUS, all stored PROSPECTUS by the default and all extraction_status PENDING (no field fed yet). All 19 PDFs were fetched and page-1 text read: 15 covers carry a 'Prospectus' title (real final prospectuses, e.g. adisoft-technologies-ltd '997.pdf', gaudium-ivf-and-women-health-ltd 'FP_INE0P8B01020_25FEB2026.pdf'), so the default was right by luck; 2 are NOT PDFs (defrail-technologies-ltd serves HTML, HTTP 404; manilam-industries-india-ltd serves a 2,331-byte 'Under Maintenance' HTML page) yet are stored as PROSPECTUS; fractal-analytics-ltd stores a sebi.gov.in viewer URL (empty file name) whose cover text carries no title (image); biopol-chemicals-ltd cover extraction failed. No annual report found among the 19: the harm measured is 2 non-documents typed as the terminal prospectus, the harm possible is any non-offer PDF.
fix_prs: #1417: detectProspectusDocType returns null when the file name names no offer type; classifyOfferDocumentCover types by the cover page title (QR note stripped; addendum/corrigendum/abridged/advertisement are not offer documents); resolveProspectusRowType downloads and types, and a row that cannot be proven an offer document (fetch failed, not a PDF, unreadable cover, no title) is reported and not stored. Existing mis-typed rows are repaired in a separate step.
detection_check: none yet. A worthwhile check: a nightly read of documents whose type is rank-bearing but whose first-page cover does not name that type (or whose stored bytes are not a PDF), reported as identities NEW/GONE/SAME. Not built in #1417, which only stops new defaulted rows.
